en: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph of a large monument featuring a statue of a man standing atop a tall pedestal, with his right arm raised. The base of the monument is decorated with numerous sculpted figures. In the foreground, people are visible near the steps of the monument. The setting appears to be an open square with mountains in the background. The bottom of the postcard has printed text.
